Avoid targeting a particular person or assuming romantic interest, and allow anyone to skip a prompt without explanation.
faq_q2: Can group flirty questions be customized for couples and bigger parties?
faq_a2: Yes. Couples can answer as partners, while bigger parties can split into smaller circles. Small groups can discuss each prompt together. Adjust the topics to the guests, respect existing relationships, and make sure every player has control over whether to answer.
